events.detail: The regression is localized: release detection runs after the visible flag is set false, so its guard can never pass. That leaves physical thrust and the power envelope active during release gaps, which explains both hidden fuel drain and later full-plume restarts. I’m confirming the behavior in Level 3 before patching.
